question: Can one source-bound Replay assessment produce traceable behavior observations, and can an integrated Editor preservation check expose requirement/capability changes before execution?
hypothesis: Separating verified execution facts, semantic behavior observations and explicit unknowns can support later response learning; explicit pre-execution requirement checks can stop declared substantive deviations without another Review call.
task_scope: Existing learning-purpose Train evidence only; reuse every available paired task and explicitly retain unexecuted/incomplete coverage.
editor_check_scope: Use only original Parent, Diagnosis and pre-execution Train evidence; never pass original Candidate outcomes to the new Editor. Save a separate construction-check artifact, not retrospective approval of the old Candidate.
replay_scope: Analyze the actual old Candidate and all its paired executions. Legacy pre-execution check is not recorded. Do not rewrite predictions, original texts, trajectories or source reports.
stop_rule: Preserve semantic stops, malformed outputs, timeouts and unknown usage. No automatic repair/retry or environment comparison is authorized by this plan.
